definition.left_condition: same source + Source Prompt + Source CoT(left) + Target CoT(left)
definition.paired_switch_success: same seed produces strict left under left CoT and strict right under right CoT
definition.right_condition: same source + Source Prompt + Source CoT(left) + Target CoT(right)
definition.strict_left: left proxy succeeds and largest lower-image red component centroid x < 270
definition.strict_right: right proxy succeeds and largest lower-image red component centroid x >= 810
definition.warning: Automatic red and centroid proxies require visual review for exact object count and semantic quality.
